name: Redis Insight
description: Redis Insight lets you do both GUI- and CLI-based interactions in a fully-featured desktop GUI client.
composeYaml:
services:
  redisinsight:
    image: 'redis/redisinsight:2.70'
    environment:
      - RI_APP_HOST=0.0.0.0
      - RI_APP_PORT=5540
      - 'RI_ENCRYPTION_KEY=${RI_ENCRYPTION_KEY}'
      - 'RI_LOG_LEVEL=${RI_LOG_LEVEL:-info}'
      - 'RI_FILES_LOGGER=${RI_FILES_LOGGER:-true}'
      - 'RI_STDOUT_LOGGER=${RI_STDOUT_LOGGER:-true}'
    volumes:
      - 'redis_insight_data:/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - '--spider'
        - 'http://0.0.0.0:5540/api/health'
      interval: 10s
      retries: 3
      timeout: 10s
      start_period: 10s
